chapter.heading: Bildad: Job Should Repent
chapter.v:
Then Bildad
the Shuhite answered and said:

“How long
will you speak these things,And the words of your mouth be like a strong wind?

Does God
subvert judgment?Or does the Almighty pervert justice?

If your
sons have sinned against Him,He has cast them away for their transgression. [Job 6:30]

If you
would earnestly seek GodAnd make your supplication to the Almighty,

If you
were pure and upright,Surely now He would awake for you,And prosper your rightful dwelling place. [[Ezra 9:13]]

Though your
beginning was small,Yet your latter end would increase abundantly. [Job 33:12, 13; 36:26; [Eccl. 3:11; Rom. 11:33]]

“Forinquire, please,
of the former age,And consider the things discovered by their fathers;

For we
were born yesterday, and know nothing,Because our days on earth are a shadow.

Will they
not teach you and tell you,And utter words from their heart? [Job 9:12; [Rev.]

“Can the
papyrus grow up without a marsh?Can the reeds flourish without water? [[Ps. 10:14]]

While it
is yet green and not cut down,It withers before any other plant. [[Ps. 39:5]; Rom. 1:22]

So are
the paths of all who forget God;And the hope of the hypocrite shall perish, [[1 Sam. 7:3]] [Ps. 88:9]

Whose confidence
shall be cut off,And whose trust is a spider’s web. [Ps. 101:3]

He leans
on his house, but it does not stand.He holds it fast, but it does not endure. [Job 22:26; Ps. 119:6; [1 John]

He grows
green in the sun,And his branches spread out in his garden. [Is. 65:16]

His roots
wrap around the rock heap,And look for a place in the stones. [Ps. 37:6; Prov. 4:18; Is. 58:8,]

If he
is destroyed from his place,Then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’

“Behold, this
is the joy of His way,And out of the earth others will grow.

Behold, God
will not cast away the blameless,Nor will He uphold the evildoers. [Lev. 26:16; Deut. 28:65; Job 17:5 o Job 18:14;]

He will
yet fill your mouth with laughing,And your lips with rejoicing.

Those who
hate you will be clothed with shame,And the dwelling place of the wicked will come to nothing.”
